problems.text: Instagram has refused every call since 2026-10-17T17:59:53.939Z ("Instagram POST /17841462809508508/media: API access blocked. (code 200)"). The agent retries every 30 minutes. Fix: make a fresh access token (Meta app dashboard → Manage messaging and content on Instagram → API setup with Instagram login → Generate token) and save it as the IG_ACCESS_TOKEN secret. Also check the Instagram app for a "confirm it's you" notice.
The GH_PAT secret is missing, so the Instagram token can't renew itself and will stop working about 60 days after it was made. Add GH_PAT (docs/SETUP.md, step "Token").
